reader.requirement: At --std 85 the RERUN, SAME [RECORD] AREA and MULTIPLE FILE TAPE clauses of the I-O-CONTROL paragraph must be accepted in any order and interleaving (the paragraph closed by one separator period), with no order-based refusal.

edition-consulted.switches: Constructs.RerunRemoved2002: RERUN admitted at 85, COBOL0902 from 2002
Constructs.MultipleFileTapeRemoved2002: MULTIPLE FILE TAPE admitted at 85, refused from 2002

reader.edition-search: The order itself is edition-blind: the grammar is (ioControlClause DOT?)*, ClauseCardinalities has no I-O-CONTROL row (ClauseCardinality.cs says so), so ScreenClauseRepetition's per-edition ClauseList.At ranking never reaches it; ScreenParagraphPeriods is the same at every edition. The edition consults on the path are the 2002 removal gates of RERUN and MULTIPLE FILE, which admit those clauses at 85.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes, not in order: RERUN and MULTIPLE FILE TAPE exist only at 85; the any-order acceptance is the same at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses test the period placement and an unrecognized clause; not exercised: the three 1985 clauses in permuted and interleaved orders

probes.expected: RERUN, SAME RECORD, MULTIPLE ... POSITION, SAME AREA, RERUN interleaved accepted
clauses separated by semicolon and comma accepted

probes.printed: error COBOL3407: I-O-CONTROL paragraph: a separator period follows 'SAME AREA FOR F1 F2' and the paragraph goes on with 'RERUN ...'
probes.expected: refused: the 1985 format prints one period after all the clauses (a punctuation rule, not an order rule)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.2.10.3 SR1  (2.10.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1 [The order of appearance of the clauses is immaterial]
OK  §1985:VII.2.12.3 SR3  (2.12.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3 [implementor-name-1 must be given in the RERUN clause] (why the first probe draft drew COBOL6530)

reader.notes: Every permutation and interleaving probed compiled and ran at --std 85; no screen ranks I-O-CONTROL clauses. A first draft drew COBOL6530 (RERUN ON file-name with integer RECORDS needs implementor-name-1, §1985:VII.2.12.3 SR3) and COBOL6826 (READ without AT END), both correct 1985 refusals of my probe, not of the order.

refuter.evidence: q4a.cob (run, --std 85, exit 0, prints ABCD through the shared record area): one I-O-CONTROL sentence interleaving the Sort-Merge module's SAME SORT AREA, RERUN ON implementor-name EVERY 100 RECORDS OF an INDEXED file, MULTIPLE FILE TAPE, SAME RECORD AREA (sequential plus indexed), RERUN ... CLOCK-UNITS, SAME AREA, RERUN ON file EVERY switch condition-name, SAME SORT-MERGE AREA: no order-based refusal. The first draft drew two COBOL2738s that are correct 1985 SAME rules, not order rules (§1985:XI.2.5.3 SR5b sort file in two SAME SORT clauses; SR5c). q4b.cob: the 2023 APPLY COMMIT clause in I-O-CONTROL is refused at 85 (COBOL0900). Grammar CobolIO.g4#ioControlParagraph is (ioControlClause DOT?)*, and FileControlBinder.IoControl.cs#ScreenRerunClauses has no order test (read). cite.py: OK §1985:VII.2.10.3 SR1 [The order of appearance of the clauses is immaterial]; OK §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR5b [must not appear in more than one SAME SORT AREA or SAME SORT-MERGE AREA clause].
